calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout and misplaced focus after an invalid number

primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show all three closures.
primary_action.observed: 6 m received visible focus; the riverside path, ferry and footbridge closures appeared.

A-1440.edge_observation: Two Left Arrows selected 2 m. Only the riverside path closure remained; the waterline aligned with the 2 m mark and was readily discernible within five seconds.
A-1440.fact_check: At 6 m the water surface meets the 6 m line at the footbridge. The three requested outcomes are visible. Actual local closure conditions were not independently verified.
A-1440.strength: The cross-section connects each crossing and threshold directly to the water level.
A-1440.weakness: The large title consumes substantial space alongside the task.
A-1440.repair: Reduce the title slightly to give the closure list more prominence.

primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show all three closures.
primary_action.observed: 6 m received visible focus and all three outcomes were readable in the first 390 × 844 viewport.

A-390.edge_observation: Two Left Arrows selected 2 m and left only the riverside path closure. The waterline aligned with the 2 m guide and was discernible within five seconds.
A-390.fact_check: At 6 m the visible water surface meets the 6 m guide at the footbridge. The diagram and all three outcomes fit in the first viewport. Actual local closure conditions were not independently verified.
A-390.strength: The compact stacked layout keeps the controls, outcomes and labeled illustration together.
A-390.weakness: The crossing drawings are small on mobile.
A-390.repair: Increase the contrast or size of crossing details while keeping the outcome list in the first viewport.

primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show all three closures.
primary_action.observed: 6 m received visible focus; the riverside path, ferry and footbridge closures appeared.

B-1440.edge_observation: Two Left Arrows selected 2 m and left only the riverside path closure. The visible horizontal water line aligned with the 2 m mark and was discernible within five seconds.
B-1440.fact_check: At 6 m the visible water line lies near the 6 m mark at the top of the tank. The tank is an abstract scale study; its terraces do not identify the individual crossings. Actual local closure conditions were not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The porcelain-and-glass scale study is distinctive and the controls have clear focus.
B-1440.weakness: The image does not explain which terrace corresponds to each closure.
B-1440.repair: Label the terraces or connect each one to its crossing and height.

primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show all three closures.
primary_action.observed: 6 m received visible focus and all three outcomes were readable in the first 390 × 844 viewport.

B-390.edge_observation: Two Left Arrows selected 2 m and left only the riverside path closure. The water line aligned with the 2 m guide and was discernible within five seconds.
B-390.fact_check: At 6 m the water line is near the top 6 m guide, though its fine line is small. All three outcomes fit in the first viewport. Actual local closure conditions were not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The closure list remains concise and readable above the image.
B-390.weakness: The small, abstract tank requires the reader to connect the image to crossings without labels.
B-390.repair: Add crossing labels to the scale and strengthen the mobile waterline.

preference.reason: Both views support the keyboard task and show all three outcomes in the first mobile viewport. A makes the relationship between water height and each named crossing immediately legible in the illustration, while B's distinctive tank leaves that relationship abstract.

scope: Matched draft comparison with the archived round-five River candidate. Both versions show the same closure facts. The experimental tank is an authored design treatment, not a retrieval result.
decision: Keep the original. The prototype passed its keyboard, aspect-ratio and visibility checks at 320, 390 and 1440 px. The blind critic preferred the original’s clearer crossing-to-height relationship.
